requirements_summary: Primary workload = agent-assist/chat for support reps + KB semantic search (embeddings) and periodic reranking for ticket routing. Latency targets: p95 < 800ms for chat agent responses during business hours. Throughput target: sustained 15 QPS with ability to handle 50 QPS short bursts. Cost sensitivity: moderate-high; want predictable reserved commit but need burst capacity. Model preference: high-quality instruction-tuned 13B-level models or equivalent with quantized variants for cost. Routing/fallback: prefer routing to cheaper hosted variants for non-critical queries; fall back to smaller model if Dedicated saturated. Security: enterprise SSO/SAML, audit logs, KMS for key control, data residency in US required.
capacity_sizing:
Observed metrics from Hosted API trial (4-week window):
- Average request mix (trial): 62% chat, 30% embeddings, 8% reranking.
- Average tokens per request (weighted): 644 tokens/request (chat avg ~900 tokens total; embeddings ~256 tokens; rerank ~120 tokens).
- Trial traffic sample: ~15k requests/week -> extrapolate target baseline 60k requests/week (240k/month) for production pilot.
- Monthly token estimate (baseline): ~240k * 644 ≈ 155M tokens/month.
- Observed concurrency: avg 6 concurrent in-flight generations; peak concurrency observed 20; p95 latency on hosted = ~480ms for chat (single-threaded gen). Peak observed QPS: 12 during simulated load tests; target sustained QPS for dedicated = 15, burst 50.

Sizing recommendation (initial reserved Dedicated):
- Start: 2 x 80GB GPUs (e.g., A100/H100 class) configured with optimized runtime + quantized 13B model variant. Provides steady-state throughput to meet ~15 QPS with p95 < 700ms for our token mix.
- Autoscale policy: scale to 4 GPUs for sustained above 25 QPS and allow burst to 6 GPUs for short spikes (up to ~50 QPS) with autoscaling cooldowns.
- Caching: enable prefix/KV cache for recurring conversational context to reduce token compute ~12-18% depending on session reuse.
- Routing policy: route low-importance reranking/embeddings to hosted_api (cheaper) during peak to keep dedicated SLOs.

Estimated committed pricing expectation (customer asks):
- Reserved baseline (2 GPUs) with support/observability: ballpark $30k-$45k/month depending on term length and reserved discounts.
- Autoscale buffers and burst capacity (4-6 GPUs available) increases committed cost or adds burst rate charges; expected blended cost range $30k-$90k/month depending on utilization.

POC/validation plan: run 1-week soak on dedicated baseline config with real traffic sample; measure p95 latency and effective tokens/sec, then iterate to add one GPU if p95>700ms or CPU load high.

Notes: numbers are conservative; recommend technical sizing workshop (Diego + infra) with customer traffic logs (we asked for 7 days of production-like sample) to finalize GPU count and autoscale thresholds.
